name: cwx
description: 3D layout editor in React and TypeScript: grid placement, undo/redo, clearance rule, BOM in English and Vietnamese, embedded mode, assistant preview and an optimised glTF pipeline

paragraphs: A browser-based 3D editor for laying out electrical-room equipment on a 20 m × 12 m floor. The clearance check and the bill of materials update as you edit; it works with mouse or keyboard, in English and Vietnamese, can run embedded in another web application on a different origin, and has a simulated assistant that proposes fixes. Built with React 19, TypeScript, three.js (React Three Fiber), zustand and Vite.
Contents: Quick start · URL options · Scripts · Features · Using the editor · Architecture · 3D model optimisation · Performance · Assumptions · Limitations · Reset · Licences · AI assistance
